jpeg_comparison_kind: derived_from_same_YUYV; validates metering/encoding, not an independent radiometric reference

limitations: gain factors describe configuration, not pipeline enable/bypass proof
analogue gain codes are not converted with the contradicted legacy formula
this tool does not infer absolute ISO, optical shutter time or continuous-preview lock

notes: configured digital multipliers remain separate for sensor core and ISP
normal convergence and exploration completeness are separate verdicts
a reference from another illumination batch is retained but not silently applied

exposure_model.equation: Ceq=a0+a1*L+a2*L^2; L=measured nominal linear center RGB luminance
exposure_model.natural_light_reference: post-run reference only; repeated fixed-setting anchors and before/after meter readings required for drift-controlled calibration
exposure_model.timing_note: coarse/cadence model; optical timing not independently measured
